|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/corporalmisik.html</ref>

Not only is he a Biker Scout with a reasonable amount of blaster skill, he also can make a mean teamworker! When with Barich in a battle, and Misik is riding a [[Speeder Bike (Dark){{!}}Speeder Bike]] (his combat vehicle of choice!) then he adds 5 to the total power! And remember that Barich with Misik allows you to draw one destiny and reduce opponent's attrition and total power by that much.

His [[Scout Blaster]] ability is just icing on the cake. He makes this free deploy free firing weapon into a +1 weapon! That's unhealthy for any unenclosed Rebels. You can hold it in your 'holster' until a battle breaks out also, as it can deploy as a react.

Combo:

= power 13, opponents power &amp; attrition reduced by a destiny draw, forfeit 16! All that for a measly 6 force!
